articles.title: Taal Volcano logs 22 quakes as seismic activity continues
articles.description: LUCENA CITY—Taal Volcano in Batangas continues to exhibit seismic activity, recording 22 volcanic earthquakes in the past 24 hours, up from 17 the previous day. This report comes from the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) on Saturday, Oct. 17. Phivolcs data showed 139 volcanic earthquakes and 11 tremor episodes recorded from Oct. 9 to 17. The agency said the volcano had a five-minute phreatomagmatic eruption on Oct. 8. Phivolcs explained that volcanic earthquakes are generated by magmatic or magma-related processes occurring beneath or near an active volcano. articles.title: Scientists predicted doomsday for November 13, 2026. Should we be worried?
articles.description: In 1960, scientists predicted that runaway population growth would bring humanity to the brink of destruction on November 13, 2026, and their mathematical forecasts remained surprisingly accurate for decades. But as birth rates declined and population growth slowed, the terrifying prediction unraveled, revealing how even convincing scientific models can fail when human behavior changes.
